run_rules.FAIL_CORRECTNESS: any hard correctness gate is nonzero or correctness observation is incomplete after a correctness signal
run_rules.INCONCLUSIVE_ENVIRONMENT: identity, cgroup, machine, clock, isolation, namespace, image, bundle, or config validity fails
run_rules.INCONCLUSIVE_OBSERVABILITY: a required metric/oracle is absent, stale, reset without accounting, or incomplete
run_rules.INCONCLUSIVE_LOAD_GENERATOR: the requested load was not independently deliverable or driver headroom is unproven
run_rules.INCONCLUSIVE_DEPENDENCY: Redis or an unmeasured support service reaches its knee before the measured service
run_rules.FAIL_TARGET_SATURATION: the measured single service reaches a bounded saturation condition without a higher-precedence verdict
run_rules.PASS_SAFE_TIER: all safe-tier and three-formal-round conditions pass

service_train_pass.gate: all required Gate profiles produce PASS_SAFE_TIER and one reviewed safe constant set
service_train_pass.player: all four Player profiles produce PASS_SAFE_TIER and one reviewed safe constant set
service_train_pass.farm: all required Farm profiles including 1x200 and 10x200 produce PASS_SAFE_TIER
service_train_pass.worker: all work families and mixed-family fairness produce PASS_SAFE_TIER
